name: Iron Pommel
summary: In Ashenvale, the Iron Pommel is the last missing piece of Dartol's Rod. The long-dead wizard Dartol made the rod, and the night elves of Astranaar seek it to slow the furbolg attacks on their people. Druids at Dor'Danil Barrow Den kept the pommel safe until their sanctuary was overrun and they were slaughtered.

sections.title: A Slain Circle's Burden
sections.body: Dartol's Rod was split apart and scattered across Ashenvale to guard its mystic power. Night elf druids near the road south toward the Barrens took charge of the Iron Pommel. Their circle was massacred at Dor'Danil Barrow Den, and their shelter fell silent in ruins. The pommel vanished amid the destruction, swallowed by the bubbling oozes now moving through the defiled glade.

sections.title: Recovered from the Mire
sections.body: The pommel lies in the tainted hollow south of Splintertree Post, inside a sturdy chest. Those who search through the corrupt slimes find the chest intact within an ooze's acidic mass. The Iron Pommel is the final piece needed to rebuild Dartol's Rod.

faq.q: What is the Iron Pommel used for?
aliases: why do i need iron pommel
faq.answer: The Iron Pommel is the final piece needed to reassemble Dartol's Rod. Bring it to Shael'dryn at the moonwell, and she can mend the ancient artifact to help slow the furbolg attacks on the night elves of Ashenvale.
Night elf druids near the road toward the Barrens had charge of the pommel. The circle was slaughtered before the rod could be reunited, and their haven lies in ruins.

aliases: where do i get iron pommel
faq.answer: The pommel is locked inside a chest carried within one of the corrupted slimes in the tainted hollow east of the main road. The hollow lies south of Splintertree Post and north of the Barrens border.

faq.q: Who do I bring the pommel to?
faq.answer: Bring the pommel to Shael'dryn, a dryad tending the moonwell east of Iris Lake. She knows the ritual needed to reconstruct Dartol's Rod.

angles.text: As a druid, you can remember the fallen druids of Dor'Danil, whose sacred charge ended in slaughter at the forest's edge.
As an Alliance member, retrieving the pommel brings Dartol's Rod closer to completion, a vital aid in defending Ashenvale against creeping corruption.
